    [@2.7] %T7: sram = dma.dto_s %T6

    [@2.11] raw.profile 18, trace

    [@2.24] raw.profile 25, trace
    [@2.25] %T19: dram = dma.sto_d %T9, %T16
    [@2.26] raw.wait sub_context, source=lir(@2.6)
    [@2.27] raw.profile 23, trace
    [@2.28] raw.page_table_update vp8->pp8, vp9->pp9, vp10->pp10, vp11->pp11
    [@2.29] raw.profile 28, trace
    [@2.30] %T11: sram = rngd_cmd.tu_exec %T7, %T10
    [@2.31] raw.wait dma(0), source=lir(@2.7)
    [@2.32] %T17: dram = cluster_sync %T19
    [@2.33] %T18: dram = index_write %T4, %T5, %T17
    [@2.34] raw.wait main_context, source=lir(@2.8)
    [@2.35] raw.profile 29, trace
    [@2.36] %T15: dram = dma.sto_d %T11, %T12
    [@2.37] raw.wait dma(0), source=lir(@2.11)
    [@2.38] raw.profile 44, trace
    [@2.39] raw.sync_release cluster, timestamp=2, from=explicit_sync(lir(@2.12))
    [@2.40] %T13: dram = cluster_sync %T15
    [@2.41] %T14: dram = index_write %T3, %T5, %T13
    [@2.42] raw.sync_acquire cluster, timestamp=2, from=explicit_sync(lir(@2.12))
    [@2.43] raw.profile 45, trace
    [@2.44] raw.update_base_timestamp 2
    yield %T14, %T18
}
